<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918081_theRebbe_229" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918081_theRebbe_229__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section expresses the wish that all this be revealed tangibly, like pointing at the matzah and wine of the future feast of Moshiach, with joy and without any delay.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And may it be His will that all this be in actual revelation, in a manner that each one points with his finger and says, "This!"</t>
    <t s="2">— analogous to the feast of Moshiach, where they point with the finger at the matzah and the wine,</t>
    <t s="3">and in the inner dimension—analogous to the matzah and the cups of the feast of Moshiach, which become blood and flesh like his flesh,</t>
    <t s="4">and out of joy and goodness of heart,</t>
    <t s="5">and immediately, forthwith,</t>
    <t s="6">that it should not delay even for the blink of an eye.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
